summary: Frontend-only verification of the same-origin BACKEND_URL fix. Both super@test.com/newpass123 and admin@test.com/admin123 log in successfully and redirect to /clients. Client Management renders 3 seeded clients with stat cards (Total 3, Active 2, Inactive 1, Platforms 2). Navigation to Campaigns and User Management works and loads data. Invalid credentials keep user on /login (401 shown). All /api/* requests target the current preview origin (c3ed9c44-...preview.emergentagent.com/api/...). ZERO requests to any 'choice-maker-43' host. No CORS errors. The permanent fix (window.location.origin) is working as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js correctly derives BACKEND_URL from window.location.origin with SSR-safe fallback — good.
Minor: 401 on invalid login is logged as a console error (expected axios behavior); acceptable but could be suppressed by catching in Login.js.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seed (3 clients, 3 campaigns, 4 users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The frontend now uses window.location.origin for BACKEND_URL — immune to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL reverts. Verified via network capture: all API calls go to same origin as page. iteration_4 confirms login fix is permanent from browser perspective.
rca of the issue: Previously REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was getting reverted to a dead 'choice-maker-43...' host by platform checkpoints, causing browser to POST /api/auth/login to a dead backend. Fix: replace env-based BACKEND_URL with window.location.origin in utils/auth.js and 10 pages. Verified in browser: origin='https://c3ed9c44-...preview.emergentagent.com', all /api requests use that origin, logins return 200.
